role: Independent proxy/measurement reviewer of the EFC corpus; AI-review, not independent validation.
independence_caveat: Same model family as the other five reviewers; agreement is reading consistency, not independent validation.

findings.excerpt: Target: unobserved entropy-production/relaxation rate Gamma(rho), equivalently the scalar-flow source in Box phi = Gamma(rho). Measurer: inverse-model operator reconstructing Gamma from density evolution, not a named sensor. Instrument: background and growth probes H(z), BAO, RSD, lensing. Proxy chain: rho -> grid-mode activation -> Gamma_A -> scalar flow -> predicted H(z)/growth -> survey data.
findings.conflict_class: measurement-category ambiguity: Gamma is a dynamical theoretical quantity discussed as inferable; a proxy-chain issue, not a physical contradiction.
findings.falsified_by: A reconstruction showing observed H(z)/growth/lensing cannot be produced by any Gamma_A with the stated saturation and rho_crit relation.

findings.excerpt: Target: entropy-production rate from BE occupation, von Neumann entropy and mode activation. Measurer: chain-rule model-inference dS/drho plus D_eff. No direct instrument. Proxy chain: rho -> x -> BE occupation -> s(n) -> per-mode Gamma ~ n(n+1) -> D_eff -> Gamma_B -> cosmological response.
findings.conflict_class: proxy-chain under-specification: forward derivation explicit, inverse measurer from data back to Gamma not operationally specified.
findings.falsified_by: A first-principles or observationally constrained reconstruction rejecting the n(n+1), D_eff or rho^(3/2) chain.

findings.excerpt: Target: effective density of gravitationally active grid modes and the resulting entropy-production bridge. Instrument: no direct grid-mode detector; indirect cosmological surveys plus possible lattice simulation. Proxy chain: rho and grid parameters -> activation threshold -> D_eff ~ sqrt(rho) -> Gamma_C -> predicted expansion/growth/lensing.
findings.conflict_class: proxy-chain/instrument gap: microphysical forward mechanism provided, but no direct observation of active grid modes or Gamma.
findings.falsified_by: Grid-microdynamics or indirect inference producing a different D_eff exponent, a nonconstant transition density, or a Gamma shape inconsistent with sqrt(rho) saturation.

findings.excerpt: Public Ledger names SPARC175/MaNGA for galaxy rotation curves. mu_A = 1/(exp(g/a0)-1) is a proposed form, not a direct measurement of a microscopic occupation number. The public observational channel uses the sqrt form for mu(g).
findings.conflict_class: category distinction: observed kinematic proxy versus inferred gravitational response; no direct BE-mode instrument.
findings.falsified_by: A statistically robust RAR likelihood rejecting one form after systematics treatment.

findings.excerpt: Public Ledger: sqrt BE exponent for mu(g) in the observational channel; Gamma_C as Scenario B+ bridge; Gamma_A as the 31942821 theory description. Code: sqrt BE occupation, Gamma_B total, Gamma_A retained as phenomenological ansatz.
findings.conflict_class: public-surface conflict plus DOI-metadata/code conflict; an implementation/provenance inconsistency, not automatic physical falsification.
findings.falsified_by: A provenance audit showing no single versioned canonical choice maps consistently from public statement to DOI artifact to executable code.

findings.excerpt: Three candidate definitions of one intended dynamical quantity Gamma(rho), not three independent observables or instruments. The distinct exponents encode competing mechanisms: density saturation (A), BE+von Neumann with exponent 3/2 (B), boundary-mode density of states (C).
findings.falsified_by: Evidence that the three forms correspond to different operational targets with distinct measurement operators and non-equivalent data channels.

findings.excerpt: Gamma is derived from grid-mode statistics, entropy and mode activation rather than postulated; operationally, when inferred from cosmological data, it is also a proxy for an unobserved process. Compatible at different levels: emergent ontologically, proxy operationally.
findings.conflict_class: ontology-versus-measurement-level ambiguity, not a physical contradiction.
findings.falsified_by: A direct measurement showing Gamma is a primitive independent observable unrelated to the proposed mechanism, or reconstruction showing no emergent Gamma accounts for the measured response.

verdict: The material supports one intended unobserved dynamical target Gamma(rho) with three competing definitions rather than three independent observables. Gamma is emergent in the theory but functions as a proxy when inferred from cosmological observables. The public observational surface uses the square-root BE exponent for mu(g), not a direct Gamma measurement. The DOI packages are split between Gamma_A (31942821), Gamma_C (31942800), and mu_B (31878760). The executable code uses mu_B and Gamma_B, retaining Gamma_A only as a phenomenological comparison. This is a public-surface/DOI/code provenance conflict, not a physical falsification.
falsification: First freeze a canonical version and publish an operational inverse measurement definition for Gamma. Then test against independent background, growth and lensing data, and mu against independent RAR samples. A provenance audit that cannot reconcile public HTML, DOI metadata and code should be reported as a reproducibility failure even if a physical fit remains viable.
